title: Scrollcraft: a Claude Code skill for premium scroll-driven websites
description:
Scrollcraft is a Claude Code skill for building scroll-driven sites without recycling the same landing-page skeleton. It chooses from eight incompatible page grammars, plans one visual peak, and requires a signature interaction plus a fingerprint check against earlier builds. Scroll becomes the animation timeline, while a headless-browser pass hunts for dead scrolling, unreadable contrast, faded copy, and broken video. 

https://github.com/nateherkai/scroll-craft
